en: to move around something in a circle
ex: The earth revolves around the sun.
地球绕太阳公转。

zh: 围绕；以…为中心；将…作为主要兴趣（或主题）
en: to move around something in a circle
ex: The earth revolves around the sun.
地球绕太阳公转。

en: a small gun that has a container for bullets that turns around so that shots can be fired quickly without having to stop to put more bullets in
ex: The man stood over him, aiming the revolver at his head.
那个男人站在他上方，用左轮手枪指着他的头。

en: able to turn in a circle
ex: a revolving chair
转椅

zh: 中转站（指人们进入后很快又离开的地方或机构）
en: a type of door in an entrance to a large building that turns around in a circle as people go through it
ex: She saw him heading towards the revolving door.
她看见他朝那旋转门走过去。

en: a show in a theatre, with songs, dances, jokes, short plays, etc., often about recent events
a strong feeling of horror
ex: Most people viewed the bombings with revulsion.
大多数人对爆炸事件表现出惊恐不安。

en: a thing that you are given because you have done something good, worked hard, etc.
ex: a financial reward
经济奖励

en: worth doing; that makes you happy because you think it is useful or important
ex: a rewarding experience/job
有益的经历／工作

zh: （大片土地的）野化，恢复原始样貌
en: the practice of helping large areas of land to return to their natural state
ex: There is a proposal for the rewilding of the islands.
有人建议恢复这些岛屿的自然样貌。

zh: 使（影片、录音、视频等）倒回；倒带
en: to make something such as a film or a recording go back to the beginning or to an earlier point

zh: a button that you press to go back to an earlier part of a film/movie, piece of music, etc.
en: a button that you press to go back to an earlier part of a film/movie, piece of music, etc.
ex: Hit the rewind button and listen to the song again.
点击快退按钮，然后再次收听歌曲。

zh: 给（建筑物或设备）换新电线
en: to put new electrical wires into a building or piece of equipment
ex: The house has been rewired.
房子已经改好了。

en: to write or say something again using different words in order to make it clearer or more acceptable
the act of writing something again using different words in order to make it clearer or more acceptable; something that has been written again in this way
to make changes to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable
ex: We’re constantly reworking our old songs.
我们在不断修改我们的老歌。
